info.title: tasks-app API
info.description: Modular workspace-scoped issue tracker. JSON snake_case fields, UUID identifiers, date-only YYYY-MM-DD values, ISO UTC timestamps. PATCH issue/project/comment requires expected version. Cookie mutations require X-Tickets-CSRF: 1 and a matching Origin when provided. Personal tokens use Authorization: Bearer. All endpoints are private except health, readiness, OpenAPI, login, invitation acceptance and signature-verified webhook receivers. Errors use {error:{code,message,details?,request_id}}. This API is not wire-compatible with Linear GraphQL.
